name: shaughv-tasks
description: Emmett Shaughnessy's standalone task + workplace-memory plugin — seven SHAUGHV tasks-* skills that create a self-contained `.tasks/` board and memory in any repo: milestones, prerequisites/owners, compact typed continuation packets, functional/evidence finish lines, preservation invariants, authoritative oracles, conditional evidence receipts and causal attempt ledgers, authorized-only waivers, milestone qualification tasks, progressive working slices, and bounded route audits. The project-named dashboard runs on a zero-dependency identity-verified Node server; boards may be git-shared or local, with a gitignored secure/ tier. Durable task state remains model-neutral and resumable across Claude, Codex, operators, and other agents without transcript dumps or false completion from unavailable evidence.
